what: Tier2 Approach says unknown flags become DEFECT but Edge cases require SKIPPED_FLAG_CHECK when help omits a real flag
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer follows Approach and false-fails good plans or follows Edge cases and contradicts validator contract text
suggested_fix: Make one normative matrix in validate-plan-commands.md and SKILL hooks: when to emit DEFECT unknown-flag vs SKIPPED flag-not-in-help vs no-help

what: Gate B and discussion paths re-run ACTION=EMIT_PLAN after plan.txt edits but proposed SKILL only validates commands right after first EMIT_PLAN and at Step 5c
scenario_or_breakage: Operators assume early Step 2b validation still holds while Step 3b-4 run on revised plan with new bash defects undetected until publish prep
suggested_fix: Add ACTION=VALIDATE_PLAN_COMMANDS after every post-revision EMIT_PLAN or document that only Step 5c re-checks composed content

what: validate-plan.sh input switching between plan.txt and composed-plan.md is hand-waved without ACTION ARGS env or file token in the action line
scenario_or_breakage: Driver or wrapper picks wrong file silent success or spurious defects
suggested_fix: Specify ACTION=VALIDATE_PLAN_COMMANDS ARGS=--plan-phase early|final or a dedicated env var parsed by validate-plan.sh in design-driver.md and SKILL bash blocks

what: Tier3 replays parsed argv with real execution only bounded by timeout
scenario_or_breakage: Malicious or buggy plan could invoke unintended repo script paths or broaden blast radius if parser mis-tokenizes
suggested_fix: Document and enforce repo-root path normalization reject .. tokens require script path match allowlist prefixes before exec and run from known cwd

what: TSV rows for script paths and flags lack escaping rules
scenario_or_breakage: Tab newline or quote in a path breaks downstream TSV consumer
suggested_fix: Define TSV escaping or forbid nonportable characters in parse-plan-commands.md and add parser tests

what: New harness targets shard placement and .PHONY wiring left to implementer
scenario_or_breakage: Missed shard hook drops tests from CI until someone notices
suggested_fix: Assign explicit test-harnesses-N targets and mirror patterns from neighboring test-* entries in the Makefile edit checklist

what: Validator is entirely custom parser plus --help grep
scenario_or_breakage: High maintenance drift versus evolving script CLI
suggested_fix: Consider hybrid: shellcheck/bash -n on fenced blocks plus narrow manifest for Tier3 dry-run registry only

what: Design centers on new markdown tokenizer and per-row --help scraping
scenario_or_breakage: False positives negatives and maintenance cost versus static tooling or generated flag DB
suggested_fix: Spike shellcheck or generated flag manifest alongside parser note tradeoff in plan

what: Tier2 Approach flags absent from help as DEFECT but Edge cases require SKIPPED_FLAG_CHECK reason=flag-not-in-help for terse help
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer ships contradictory behavior or picks the wrong branch
suggested_fix: Make one normative decision table in validate-plan-commands.md and align Approach Edge cases and SKILL text to it

what: validate-plan.sh toggles plan.txt vs composed-plan.md without an ACTION ARGS or env contract
scenario_or_breakage: Driver may validate wrong artifact or double-hit wrong phase
suggested_fix: Specify ARGS token or env var on ACTION lines and document parsing in design-driver.md and validate-plan.md

what: Tier3 executes reconstructed argv with timeout as main guard
scenario_or_breakage: Mis-tokenized or path-traversal argv widens blast radius
suggested_fix: Require normalized repo-relative paths reject .. enforce allowlist prefixes pin cwd and test malicious rows

what: Which test-harnesses shard owns new targets is unspecified
scenario_or_breakage: Omission drops new harnesses from lint until noticed
suggested_fix: Name shard and .PHONY entries in the Makefile plan section

what: Custom markdown tokenizer plus per-row --help grep only
scenario_or_breakage: High drift false positives versus evolving CLIs
suggested_fix: Consider hybrid shellcheck bash -n or generated flag manifest alongside parser document tradeoff
